page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head at the top (title, year and page number). No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: quidlibet contra serenif. noftrum regem aggredi, aut vindictam contra adversarios noftros in Anglia exercere, (quos in ampliffimis Angliæ comitiis judicari petimus) aut occupatis Anglorum bonis nosmet locupletare, ullam denique omnino Angliæ injuriam inferre: quin contra operam omnem & facultates noftras in ipforum Anglorum commodum lubenter profundemus, prout gratitudinis leges postulant, ob auxilia olim nobis præstita in ipsis primæ noftræ reformationis exordiis, quibus à tyrannide factionis Gallico-Guisianæ liberatos nos fuisse grata mente recolimus: firmum manebit hoc æterni in Anglos amoris & pacis vinculum, Conscientia noftra, & Deus conscientiis noftris major nobis testantur, solam nobis propositam esse Dei gloriam, utriusque gentis firmam pacem, & genuinum serenissimi regis noftri honorem; & ut legitime ac ordine in Israelis turbatores animadvertatur, incendiarios istos intelligimus ab inferis excitatos, Corahos, Balaamos, Doegos, Rhabshakeos, Hamanos, Tobiahos, Sanballatos hodiernos; quo peracto nobis abunde satisfiet. Neque militarem hanc expeditionem in Angliam ut medium ad sanctos illos fines obtinendos prius aggressi sumus, quam alia omnia irrita hostium vafritie reddita nobis effent: ita quidem ut hoc ultimum & unicum remedium nobis nunc superfit.

6. Si Domino visum fuerit expeditioni huic benedicere, & peccata noftra ac Anglorum oppositio non obstent, quam dulces fructus utraque gens simul cum posteris carpet, ac quanto futuri sunt solatio exteris reformatis ecclesiis suaves eventus? Nam reformatio Scotiæ ad primævam suam formam revocabitur, Angliæ vero reformatio, tot piorum precibus frequentissimè expetita, perfectionem suam tandem assequetur; tum in doctrinæ ac cultus, tum in disciplinæ puritate: Pontificii præsules, & mem-

page.notes: Running head and year read as printed: "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." and "1640." Page number 541 at upper right. The word "serenif." is printed with a long-s form and an abbreviation point; transcribed as "serenif." Doubtful: "Guisianæ" (printed as "Guifiane" in the scan, read here as Guisianæ with italic type); "Rhabshakeos" printed as "Rhabshakeos". The mark ᴗ and small strokes at the lower margin are a printer's mark or show-through and are not transcribed. No signature visible.
